messages:
Alexa (PR): Quick sync — need to lock press fact-check windows for the launch next Tue (Apr 15). Journalists are asking about 24h vs 48h quote windows and a press dinner invite in SF. Prefer short replies so I can reply to them.

Matt (Growth): Leaning 24h for technical quotes, 48h for analyst pieces. Legal said 24h is OK if we label it ‘fact-check only’ and prohibit new claims.

Camila (Media): Agree. Offer two clear options in the reply: 24h fact-check (minor edits only) or 48h with on-the-record quote approval. Give cut-off times in PST. Also ask if they need embargo exception for AP-style pickups.

Ryan (Ops): Logistically, dinner on Mon Apr 14 works for most folks. Venue TBD. Need AV + 2 lapel mics for short demos. Who's owning RSVPs and dietary prefs?

Elaine (Editor): Recommend one canonical quote template and a redline flow — reduces back-and-forth. Putting a stub here.

```
"Redwood Inference is launching [product] on [date]. We confirm the performance claims in the release: [benchmark summary]. For fact-checks and quote approvals contact [PR contact] by [cut-off time]. Any edits should be limited to factual corrections; no new claims or figures will be added after the cut-off."
```

Camila (Media): Also propose a 2-hour extended window for deep-dive features (long-form pieces) so reporters can double-check numbers. That covers requests from outlets doing benchmarks.

pressbot: embargo registered: 2026-04-15T09:00:00Z — available fact-check windows: 24h / 48h / 2h-extended for long-form.

Alexa (PR): Action items: Matt — confirm the 24h/48h policy copy and legal phrasing. Ryan — own RSVP + confirm venue + AV. Elaine — paste the template into Google Doc and enable suggested edits. Camila — compile reporter list with timezone preferences and flag any long-form requests. I'll reply to the first 6 press inquiries with the 24h option + dinner invite. :memo:

Matt (Growth): Will update the PR FAQ and add the policy to the media distro. ETA EOD today.

Ryan (Ops): RSVP sheet + tentative venue here: https://calendar.company.com/event/abc123 — I'll start the guest list and collect dietary restrictions.

Elaine (Editor): Done — added template to doc: https://docs.company.com/s/PR-quote-template — please use suggested edits.

Alexa (PR): Perfect. If legal pushes back we default to 48h. Thanks team :thumbsup:
